evidence: DIFF A hunk 1 (lines 1-2): migration header only - purpose of the change + puppet-nginx 8.4.0 / puppetlabs-apt 11.3.2, which header_modules confirms against the master.

DIFF A hunk 2 (nginx_base.pp:88): nginx_cfg_prepend => {'include' => '/etc/nginx/modules-enabled/*'} -> include_modules_enabled => true. This is a module-API translation, and it matches HQ batch-8 ruling 1 (class_rulings.txt:15, DESIGN_DECISIONS 2026-11-17). I checked it on the master: puppet-nginx 8.4.0 templates/conf.d/nginx.conf.erb:29-31 itself renders 'include /etc/nginx/modules-enabled/*.conf;' when include_modules_enabled is set. params.pp:124 defaults that to true on Debian, so the baseline's prepend would add a second include. config.pp manages File[modules-enabled] under the same flag. Setting it explicitly keeps the include on every OS, as the baseline did. On the applied node, /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:8 has exactly one include. The only textual difference is the glob, '*' -> '*.conf'. Debian packaging ships only *.conf there, so it has no practical effect. No resource, value, default or logic changed beyond this. DIFF B is the same single hunk (re-migration).
